result.title: Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data
result.summary: In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. These soft labels train the classifier and replace labels to select its fusion weight with zero-shot CLIP by closed-form leave-one-out cross-validation. We prove that posterior targets minimize the mean-square gap to the true-label prediction and that their argmax widens this gap only through ambiguous images. The fusion weight selected with soft labels loses at most their distance to the posteriors in expected correct decisions. PACIL has the best average incremental accuracy among methods trained without labels on all 18 settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PACIL：在每类只给类名与无标签图像的类增量学习设定下，用先验选择规则校正 CLIP 零样本预测的类别比例，再以白化特征上的固定先验 vMF 混合模型精炼为标签后验软标签，并用这些软标签训练分类器、以闭式留一交叉验证选择与零样本 CLIP 的融合权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以软后验替代硬伪标签、并用后验信号决定两个预测源融合权重的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理与视觉旁路之间的贡献分配和权重确定提供可核查线索；但该文研究类增量学习而非推理期 latent 状态，联系属于方法借鉴层面。
